class.name: GaussianSplatDynamicIslandVolume3D
class.brief_description: Extracts movable islands before HLOD partitioning.
class.description: Removes matching splat centres from the world before leaf partitioning and writes each island to its own plain v3 gsplatworld asset. Islands are always v3: no existing bake size threshold selects V4. The world persists an [code]islands[][/code] manifest with name, asset path, identity rest transform and bounds; the island payload remains in bake coordinates. Output names must be new, valid filenames. [code]island_output_dir[/code] is required by the resource bake when extraction occurs; the auto-tree defaults to a sibling directory named after the output stem with suffix .islands. Failed bakes remove only the new island files they created. The report uses a top-down XZ grid of splat centres with 0.25 m cells. [code]hole_area_m2[/code] counts island cells containing no remaining world centre; [code]island_xz_footprint_m2[/code] counts all island cells. This is report-only and measures no holes in vertical surfaces behind the island (walls, cliffs).

members.member: Optional island asset name; an empty string uses the node name.
